zh-CN.title: Mac 设置与快捷键图解指南 | MacSetup
zh-CN.description: MacSetup 提供 15 项 Mac 设置与快捷操作指南，涵盖访达、触控板、程序坞、输入法和 Mos。查看设置路径、操作步骤、修改前后与恢复方法，用本地清单记录进度。
zh-CN.guideTitle: Mac 设置与快捷键指南
zh-CN.guideIntro: MacSetup 是由 orocoa 维护的中英双语 Mac 设置指南，收录 15 项访达、系统设置、工具与快捷操作建议。每项说明设置路径、操作步骤、修改前后的变化、恢复方法与来源。
zh-CN.sourceNote: 每项指南附有来源与适用条件。部分条目记录了路径核对版本和日期；没有版本核对记录的条目不代表已适配当前所有 macOS。
zh-CN.manualNote: 在自己的 Mac 上手动修改设置。清单仅记录已处理的建议，不能检测或确认真实系统状态；进度只保存在当前浏览器。

en.title: Mac Settings & Shortcuts Guide | MacSetup
en.description: Explore 15 MacSetup guides for Finder, trackpad, Dock, input sources, Mos and keyboard shortcuts, with settings paths, before/after explanations, undo steps and a local checklist.
en.guideIntro: MacSetup is a bilingual Mac settings guide maintained by orocoa, covering 15 Finder, System Settings, utility and shortcut recommendations. Each guide explains where to find a setting, how to change it, what changes, how to undo it and its sources.
en.sourceNote: Each guide includes sources and prerequisites. Some entries record a path-review version and date; an entry without that record is not a claim of compatibility with every current macOS release.
en.manualNote: Change settings manually on your Mac. The checklist records handled recommendations and cannot detect or confirm system state. Progress stays in the current browser.
